    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    top = grid[:split]
    bottom = grid[split+1:]

    rare_top = min(set(sum(top, [])), key=sum(row.count(x) for row in top))
    rare_bottom = min(set(sum(bottom, [])), key=sum(row.count(x) for row in bottom))
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == rare_top and bottom[r][c] == rare_bottom else bg for c in range(len(top[0]))] for r in range(len(top))]
')
